patterns.what_worked: Applied the bars lane's verbatim desc, then verified every factual claim against the landed weave_range.lua before shipping it - the exact mistake being corrected was copy that outlived its module. Bound the band numbers in the copy to the module constants (NEAR/FAR/HUNTER_FAR = 5/30/35) so a retune or a copy edit reds the same pin.
patterns.what_was_hard: The follow-up asked the pin to reject the substring 'band' while the mandated copy itself says '35 yd band'/'30 yd band'. Applied the copy verbatim (it is the owning lane's sanctioned text) and pinned the actual defect wording ('banded' / 'range checks' / the library name), stating the conflict on the bench rather than silently dropping either instruction.
patterns.skill_gap: None. Reminder for copy fixes: a desc is a claim about code - cite the module lines before writing it.

escalation.recommendation: Operator: if the word 'band' must disappear from the desc entirely, the copy has to be reissued by bars-range-hunter. Otherwise nothing is blocked; run.sh registration for the appearance suite is still orchestrator-owned.
